# 1. Configuración

## 1.1 Librerías

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
pacman::p_load(
  phyloseq, qiime2R, vegan,
  zCompositions,
  ggplot2, rmarkdown, knitr,
  tibble, tidyr, stringr, rlang, dplyr
)
```

## 1.2 Rutas y constantes

```{r paths, include=FALSE}
gen_path  = getwd()
gen_path  = gsub("notebooks", "", gen_path)
data_path = paste0(gen_path, "Data")
raw_path  = paste0(data_path, "/raw")
proc_path = paste0(data_path, "/processed")

if (!dir.exists(proc_path)) dir.create(proc_path, recursive = TRUE)

env_or <- function(var, default) {
  v <- Sys.getenv(var, unset = "")
  if (nzchar(v)) v else default
}

metadata_path = env_or("PIPELINE_METADATA", paste0(raw_path, "/Metadata.csv"))
taxonomy_path = env_or("PIPELINE_TAXONOMY", paste0(raw_path, "/taxonomy-gg2.qza"))
table_path    = env_or("PIPELINE_TABLE",    paste0(raw_path, "/table-final-clean.qza"))

cat("Metadata :", metadata_path, "\n")
cat("Taxonomy :", taxonomy_path, "\n")
cat("Table    :", table_path, "\n")

cont_vars = c("gest_week", "b_bh", "g_index")

'%nin%' = Negate("%in%")

del_user = c("MB-059", "MB-061", "MB-055", "MB-001", "MB-005")
```

# 2. Carga y filtrado de metadatos

## 2.1 Carga inicial

```{r load_metadata, include=FALSE}
df = read.csv(metadata_path, sep = ";")
cat("Observaciones iniciales:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Individuos únicos:", length(unique(df$p_code)), "\n")
```

## 2.2 Exclusión de individuos

Se excluyen 5 individuos que no cumplían con los requisitos del estudio:

| ID Individuo |
|--------------|
| MB-059       |
| MB-061       |
| MB-055       |
| MB-001       |
| MB-005       |

```{r exclude_users, include=FALSE}
df = df[df$p_code %nin% del_user, ]
cat("Observaciones tras exclusión:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 2.3 Filtro de observaciones repetidas

Se retienen solo aquellos individuos con 2 o 3 muestreos:

```{r filter_repeats, include=FALSE}
df = df %>%
  group_by(p_code) %>%
  filter(n() %in% c(2, 3)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Observaciones finales:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Individuos finales:", length(unique(df$p_code)), "\n")

count_user = table(df$p_code)
cat("  - Con 2 tiempos:", sum(count_user == 2), "\n")
cat("  - Con 3 tiempos:", sum(count_user == 3), "\n")
```

## 2.4 Agregación Leche / Heces

Cada individuo aporta dos tipos de muestra (Leche y Heces) por tiempo.
Se duplica la metadata con el prefijo `ML` (leche) y `MH` (heces):

```{r aggregate_milk_stool, include=FALSE}
df1 = df
df2 = df

df1$sam_ = gsub("B", "L", df$p_code)  # Leche
df2$sam_ = gsub("B", "H", df$p_code)  # Heces

df3 = bind_rows(df1, df2)
write.csv(df3, paste0(proc_path, "/Metadata_rep.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Observaciones agregadas (Leche + Heces):", nrow(df3), "\n")
```

# 3. Carga de datos QIIME2

```{r load_qiime2, include=FALSE}
datos = qza_to_phyloseq(
  features  = table_path,
  taxonomy  = taxonomy_path
)

otu_table = data.frame(datos@otu_table)
taxonomia = data.frame(datos@tax_table)

cat("ASVs:", nrow(otu_table), "\n")
cat("Muestras:", ncol(otu_table), "\n")
```

# 4. Limpieza taxonómica

## 4.1 Ajuste de nombres de columnas

```{r fix_column_names, include=FALSE}
colnames(otu_table) = gsub(".heces", "", colnames(otu_table))
```

## 4.2 Filtro de Sphingomonas

Se identifican las muestras con menos del 30% de *Sphingomonas*
(efecto de contaminación en muestras de leche):

```{r sphingomonas_filter, include=FALSE}
# rownames(taxonomia) = taxonomia$X # Aquí las ocupé
# taxonomia = taxonomia %>% select(-X)

sphingo_otus = rownames(taxonomia)[startsWith(taxonomia$Genus, "Sphingomonas")]
sphingo_otus = intersect(sphingo_otus, rownames(otu_table))

abund_total   = colSums(otu_table)
abund_sphingo = colSums(otu_table[sphingo_otus, , drop = FALSE])
pct_sphingo   = 100 * abund_sphingo / abund_total

muestras_validas = names(pct_sphingo)  # Todas pasan el filtro
cat("Muestras tras filtro Sphingomonas:", length(muestras_validas), "\n")
```

## 4.3 Remoción de muestras Novogene

Se eliminan 7 muestras procesadas fuera del laboratorio:

```{r remove_novogene, include=FALSE}
del_novogene = c(
  "novogene.ML.006.III", "novogene.ML.006.II",
  "novogene.ML.041.III", "novogene.ML.046.I",
  "novogene.ML.050.III", "novogene.ML.064.III",
  "X01sept2021_MH.042.III"
)

del_novogene_dots = gsub("-", ".", del_novogene, fixed = TRUE)
otu_table = otu_table[, !colnames(otu_table) %in% del_novogene_dots, drop = FALSE]
cat("Muestras tras remoción Novogene:", ncol(otu_table), "\n")
```

## 4.4 Agrupación a nivel de Género

La clasificación taxonómica llega a nivel de especie. Se simplifica
a nivel de género para el análisis:

```{r tax_glom_genus, include=FALSE}
# Limpiar nombres de género y familia (quitar sufijos de especie)
taxonomia$Genus  = gsub("_.*", "", taxonomia$Genus)
taxonomia$Genus  = gsub("\\..*", "", taxonomia$Genus)
taxonomia$Family = gsub("_.*", "", taxonomia$Family)
taxonomia$Family = gsub("\\..*", "", taxonomia$Family)

otu_mat = as.matrix(otu_table)
tax_mat = as.matrix(taxonomia)
```

# 5. Construcción del objeto phyloseq

## 5.1 Alineación de metadatos

```{r align_metadata, include=FALSE}
metadata = read.csv(paste0(proc_path, "/Metadata_rep.csv"))
metadata = metadata[metadata$p_code %nin% del_user, ]

metadata$samp_n = ifelse(
  metadata$samp_n == "1", "I",
  ifelse(metadata$samp_n == "2", "II", "III")
)

metadata$sam_ = paste0(metadata$sam_, "-", metadata$samp_n)
rownames(metadata) = metadata$sam_

colnames(otu_mat) = gsub(".", "-", colnames(otu_mat), fixed = TRUE)

metadata = metadata[rownames(metadata) %in% colnames(otu_mat), ]
samples = sample_data(metadata)
rownames(samples) = gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(samples))
```

## 5.2 Aplicar filtro Sphingomonas al phyloseq

```{r apply_sphingo_filter, include=FALSE}
muestras_menos_30 = gsub(".", "-", muestras_validas, fixed = TRUE)
del_novogene_2    = gsub(".", "-", del_novogene, fixed = TRUE)
muestras_menos_30 = muestras_menos_30[muestras_menos_30 %nin% del_novogene_2]

samples = samples[rownames(samples) %in% muestras_menos_30, ]
```

## 5.3 Crear objeto phyloseq

```{r create_phyloseq, include=FALSE}
OTU = otu_table(otu_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX = tax_table(tax_mat)

OTU = OTU[, colnames(OTU) %in% rownames(samples), drop = FALSE]

HMilk_clean = phyloseq(OTU, samples, TAX)
cat("Muestras en phyloseq:", nsamples(HMilk_clean), "\n")
cat("Taxones en phyloseq:", ntaxa(HMilk_clean), "\n")
```

# 6. Filtros de calidad

## 6.1 Remoción de muestras con cero lecturas

```{r remove_zero_samples, include=FALSE}
sumas_de_muestras = sample_sums(HMilk_clean)
nombres_muestras_cero = names(sumas_de_muestras[sumas_de_muestras == 0])

if (length(nombres_muestras_cero) > 0) {
  cat("Muestras con cero lecturas:", length(nombres_muestras_cero), "\n")
  HMilk_clean = prune_samples(sample_sums(HMilk_clean) > 0, HMilk_clean)
} else {
  cat("No se detectaron muestras con cero lecturas.\n")
}
```

## 6.2 Remoción de ASVs con cero lecturas

```{r remove_zero_taxa, include=FALSE}
n_asv_ceros = sum(taxa_sums(HMilk_clean) == 0)
cat("ASVs con cero lecturas:", n_asv_ceros, "\n")

HMilk_clean = prune_taxa(taxa_sums(HMilk_clean) > 0, HMilk_clean)
cat("Taxones restantes:", ntaxa(HMilk_clean), "\n")
```

## 6.3 Filtro de prevalencia mínima (5%)

Se eliminan taxones que aparecen en menos del 5% de las muestras
de cada tipo (Leche / Heces) por separado:

```{r prevalence_filter, include=FALSE}
filter_phyloseq_by_prevalence = function(physeq, min_prevalence = 0.05) {
  prevalence = apply(
    X = otu_table(physeq),
    MARGIN = ifelse(taxa_are_rows(physeq), 1, 2),
    FUN = function(x) sum(x > 0)
  )
  prevalence_ratio = prevalence / nsamples(physeq)
  physeq_filtered  = prune_taxa(prevalence_ratio >= min_prevalence, physeq)
  
  cat("  Taxones originales:", ntaxa(physeq), "\n")
  cat("  Taxones restantes:", ntaxa(physeq_filtered), "\n")
  cat("  Eliminados:", ntaxa(physeq) - ntaxa(physeq_filtered), "\n")
  
  return(physeq_filtered)
}

sample_data(HMilk_clean)$type = ifelse(
  startsWith(sample_data(HMilk_clean)$sam_, "ML-"), "Milk", "Stool"
)

HMilk_genus = tax_glom(HMilk_clean, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

cat("Filtro de prevalencia - Leches:\n")
HMilk_filtered_milk = filter_phyloseq_by_prevalence(
  subset_samples(HMilk_genus, type == "Milk"), min_prevalence = 0.05
)

cat("Filtro de prevalencia - Heces:\n")
HMilk_filtered_stool = filter_phyloseq_by_prevalence(
  subset_samples(HMilk_genus, type == "Stool"), min_prevalence = 0.05
)

taxones_milk  = taxa_names(HMilk_filtered_milk)
taxones_stool = taxa_names(HMilk_filtered_stool)
taxones_validos = union(taxones_milk, taxones_stool)

HMilkclean_filtered = prune_taxa(taxones_validos, HMilk_genus)
cat("Taxones finales (unión Leche + Heces):", ntaxa(HMilkclean_filtered), "\n")
```

## 6.4 Rarefacción (solo para índices de diversidad)

```{r rarefaction, include=FALSE}
set.seed(999)
HMS_rarefied = rarefy_even_depth(
  HMilkclean_filtered,
  sample.size = 10000,
  rngseed = 999,
  verbose = FALSE
)
cat("Rarefacción completada (size = 10,000).\n")
```

# 7. Paleta de colores por género

Se genera una paleta donde cada familia tiene un color base y sus
géneros derivan tonos más claros:

```{r color_palette1, include=FALSE}
n_top_familias = 15

tax_df = as.data.frame(tax_table(HMilkclean_filtered))
tax_df = tax_df %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ gsub("_.*", "", .)))

top_familias = tax_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Family)) %>%
  count(Family, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = n_top_familias) %>%
  pull(Family)

tax_df
```


```{r color_palette2, include=FALSE}
tax_rel = tax_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Family, Genus) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Family) & !is.na(Genus) & Genus != "unclassified") %>%
  mutate(
    Family_Group = ifelse(Family %in% top_familias, Family, "Other")
  )

set.seed(1234)
colores_base = colorRampPalette(c(
  "#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00",
  "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#20B2AA", "#17BECF", "#BCBD22",
  "#1A6876", "#249C72", "#7BC3AC", "#D8F7EF"
))(n_top_familias)
names(colores_base) = top_familias

lista_colores_generos = list()

for (fam in top_familias) {
  generos_de_familia = tax_rel$Genus[tax_rel$Family_Group == fam]
  n_generos = length(generos_de_familia)
  color_fam = colores_base[fam]
  
  if (n_generos == 1) {
    tonos = color_fam
  } else {
    paleta_grad = colorRampPalette(c(color_fam, "white"))
    tonos = paleta_grad(n_generos + 2)[1:n_generos]
  }
  
  names(tonos) = generos_de_familia
  lista_colores_generos[[fam]] = tonos
}

generos_otros = tax_rel$Genus[tax_rel$Family_Group == "Other"]
tonos_otros = rep("#D3D3D3", length(generos_otros))
names(tonos_otros) = generos_otros
lista_colores_generos[["Other"]] = tonos_otros

vector_colores_final = unlist(lista_colores_generos)
names(vector_colores_final) = sub("^.*\\.", "", names(vector_colores_final))

other_vect = c("#D3D3D3", "#D3D3D3")
names(other_vect) = c("Others", "Other")
vector_colores_final = c(vector_colores_final, other_vect)

saveRDS(vector_colores_final, file = paste0(data_path, "/paleta_colores_generos.rds"))
cat("Paleta de colores guardada.\n")
```

# 8. Resumen del dataset limpio

```{r summary, include=FALSE}
cat("=== RESUMEN DEL DATASET LIMPIO ===\n")
cat("Muestras:", nsamples(HMilkclean_filtered), "\n")
cat("  - Leches:", sum(sample_data(HMilkclean_filtered)$type == "Milk"), "\n")
cat("  - Heces:", sum(sample_data(HMilkclean_filtered)$type == "Stool"), "\n")
cat("Taxones (Géneros):", ntaxa(HMilkclean_filtered), "\n")
cat("Individuos:", length(unique(sample_data(HMilkclean_filtered)$p_code)), "\n")
cat("\nProfundidad de secuenciación:\n")
print(summary(sample_sums(HMilkclean_filtered)))
```

# 9. Guardado de objetos

Se guardan los objetos limpios para que los archivos 02 y 03 los
carguen de forma independiente:

```{r save_objects, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(HMilkclean_filtered, file = paste0(proc_path, "/HMilkclean_filtered.rds"))
saveRDS(HMilk_genus, file = paste0(proc_path, "/HMilk_clean_genus.rds"))
saveRDS(HMS_rarefied, file = paste0(proc_path, "/HMS_rarefied.rds"))
saveRDS(metadata, file = paste0(proc_path, "/metadata_clean.rds"))
saveRDS(df, file = paste0(proc_path, "/df_clean.rds"))
saveRDS(otu_mat, file = paste0(proc_path, "/otu_raw.rds"))
saveRDS(tax_mat, file = paste0(proc_path, "/tax_raw.rds"))

cat("\nObjetos guardados en:", proc_path, "\n")
cat("  - HMilkclean_filtered.rds\n")
cat("  - HMS_rarefied.rds\n")
cat("  - metadata_clean.rds\n")
cat("  - df_clean.rds\n")
cat("  - otu_raw.rds\n")
cat("  - tax_raw.rds\n")
cat("  - paleta_colores_generos.rds (en Data/)\n")
```
